name: unverified_0000
summary: Missing access control on drain selector 0x88417d5c lets any caller transfer the victim contract's ERC20 balances to itself.

loss.notes: Imported from the seed inventory, which did not consistently distinguish gross from net loss or record valuation provenance.

limitations: Target identity and code history were imported from the seed inventory without independent review.
The executing code artifact and its code hash have not been established in structured evidence.
One or more target block, transaction, ordering, or creator anchors remain unresolved.

sources.note: Recheck of the deployment basis (DELEGATECALL audit): the unverified victim sets no EIP-1967 implementation or beacon slot and its runtime is byte-identical at the creation block 49557639 and the incident block 50311056; its single DELEGATECALL (pc 0x03c7) forwards the full calldata to an address taken from the stack after a loop comparing CALLER against a whitelist, i.e. a per-call target supplied by the caller rather than an installed implementation read from storage, so nothing about the victim's own code changed after deployment.

limitations: Classification and loss were imported from the seed inventory and await review.
The imported USD loss lacks structured valuation provenance.
